The company manufactures [[fermentation]]-based [[biopharmaceutical]] [[Active ingredient|active pharmaceutical ingredients]] (APIs) sold worldwide.{{cite news |title=Jhunjhunwala backed Concord Biotech sets IPO price band at Rs 705-741 |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/jhunjhunwala-firm-backed-concord-biotech-sets-ipo-price-band-at-rs-705-741-11062781.html |access-date=31 July 2023 |work=Moneycontrol |date=31 July 2023 |language=en}} It manufactures biopharmaceutical products across therapy segments such as [[Immunosuppressive drug|immunosuppressant]], [[oncology]], [[antifungal]], [[antibacterial]] and [[anthelmintic]]. It has two manufacturing facilities–at [[Dholka]] near [[Ahmedabad]], which is approved by [[Food and Drug Administration|USFDA]],{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/concord-biotech-mulling-new-unit-107091301081_1.html|title=Concord Biotech mulling new unit |publisher=Business Standard |accessdate=5 February 2013}} and at Limbasi in [[Kheda district]].{{cite news |last1=Somvanshi |first1=Kiran Kabtta |title=Concord Biotech's niche API play holds promise for growth |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/concord-biotechs-niche-api-play-holds-promise-for-growth/articleshow/102403715.cms |access-date=24 May 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=4 August 2023}} ==History== Concord Biotech was founded in 2000 by Sudhir Vaid, a former director at [[Ranbaxy Laboratories]]. It was the first company in India and the second in the world to develop an anti-immuno suppressant [[tacrolimus]].{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/concord-biotech-eyes-5-fold-growth-by-06-104021401085_1.html|title=Concord Biotech eyes 5-fold growth by '06 |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |accessdate=28 February 2013}} In 2004, [[Rakesh Jhunjhunwala]] acquired around 14% stake in the company. In 2005, [[Hyderabad]]-based Matrix Laboratories acquired 55% stake in the company, by buying partial shareholding of Vaid and Jhunjhunwala.{{cite news |title=Matrix takes 55% stake in Concord Bio |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/matrix-takes-55-stake-in-concord-bio-105120600007_1.html |access-date=24 May 2024 |work=Business Standard}} After Matrix Laboratories was Concord Biotech Limited (CBL) is an Indian biotechnology company headquartered in Ahmedabad. The company manufactures fermentation-based biopharmaceutical active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) sold worldwide.
It manufactures biopharmaceutical products across therapy segments such as immunosuppressant, oncology, antifungal, antibacterial and anthelmintic. It has two manufacturing facilities–at Dholka near Ahmedabad, which is approved by USFDA, and at Limbasi in Kheda district.
